scope: Corollary 1.2 (Exact uniform sampling) of the manuscript “Polynomial mixing of the switch chain for every graphical degree sequence” (preprints/Polynomial-Mixing-of-the-Switch-Chain-for-Every-Graphical-Degree-Sequence-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 131 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e70eab92c1315e67), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a uniform randomized algorithm that, given any finite graphical labeled degree vector d = (d1, . . . , dn), uses unbiased random bits, terminates almost surely, and outputs a graph chosen exactly uniformly from the simple undirected graphs on {1, . . . , n} with labeled degree vector d. Its expected bit running time is bounded by a fixed polynomial in the binary encoding length of d.
